pass.label: every section cited
pass.answer:
## Findings
Finding 1: on 17/04/2025 chilled goods were delivered above the agreed limit and stock worth £1,500 was destroyed. Finding 4: on 13/05/2025 a consignment was unloaded without the second signature and glassware worth £600 could not be accounted for. Finding 6: on 05/05/2025 a trailer was left unsecured and archive boxes worth £2,049 were lost {cite:supplier-review-calder.pdf#3}.

## Supplier's response
The supplier responded on 02/06/2025, admitting findings 1 and 6 and disputing finding 4 {cite:supplier-review-calder.pdf#5}.

## Losses claimed
The losses claimed total £4,149 {cite:supplier-review-calder.pdf#5}.

## Compliance history
The history records earlier breaches, most recently a two-month suspension from chilled work on 07/08/2023 {cite:supplier-review-calder.pdf#16}.

## Proposed outcome
The reviewer proposes a six-month probation period with monthly temperature audits; the matter is listed for the review panel on 15/07/2025 {cite:supplier-review-calder.pdf#5}.
